text:
Victor Olofsson came back to Vegas after a season split between Colorado and Calgary, and the return is going well. He has 8 goals and 12 points in 12 games, and since rejoining the lineup Nov. 5 after a month out, his ice time is up 2:10 a night. His last ten games: 10 points, seven goals, against 6.8 expected at his minutes.

Part of that is earned. His own chances over the stretch are worth 3.8 expected goals against 2.8 usual (expected goals measure chance quality), and at 5v5 Vegas has 68.4% of the expected goals with him on the ice. One of his goals was the one Mark Stone set up on Nov. 19 to become the franchise points leader.

Part of it is not. Eight goals on 4.0 expected means 28.6% shooting, after 9% last season, and our talent range puts him nearer 13.1%. Evolving-Hockey had him at replacement level last season and noted how strong his teammates were.

Yahoo Sports called him "a driving force during second Vegas stint." The chances back the hot run. The finishing is the piece to watch.
